name: Duolingo
mood: Playful classroom mascot on white paper, with rounded display type, saturated green progress language, Spark Blue links, sticker-like controls, and illustration-led sections.

eagerGreen.role: Green accent for progress, display headings, primary CTA fills, and footer band.

storybookGreen.role: Soft green wash for highlighted labels and light surface tints.

sparkBlue.role: Interactive links and outlined secondary CTAs.

freshLeaf.role: Secondary green link tone for footer or green-band contexts.

nightInk.role: Deep violet-blue accent for emphasis text and dark surfaces.

paperWhite.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, and text on green or dark fills.

charcoal.role: Hero headings and primary dark copy.

pencilGray.role: Body paragraphs and secondary descriptive text.

fadedGray.role: Button borders, disabled states, and low-emphasis nav labels.

families.featherFallback: Feather Bold, Nunito Black, rounded extra-bold sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui
families.duolingoSansFallback: DIN Next, Inter, Nunito Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui

rules: Use Feather-style rounded display only at 48px and above.
Use duolingo-sans style typography for body, nav, labels, subheadings, and links.
Reserve uppercase 15px with 0.0530em tracking for nav labels and language pills.
Keep body copy gray at 17px and weight 500.

outlinedControl.role: Sticker-like border for outlined buttons, language pills, and nav-item controls.

paperWhite.role: Page canvas and default section surface.

eagerGreen.role: Footer band and primary CTA fill.

nightInk.role: Deep accent surface for dark emphasis.

components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.recipe: Eager Green fill, Paper White uppercase 15px/700 text, 0.0530em tracking, 12px radius, 16px horizontal padding, no shadow.

components.name: Outlined Account Button
components.recipe: Transparent fill, Spark Blue 14px/700 text, 12px radius, 16px horizontal padding, 2px Faded Gray border.

components.name: Nav Language Pill
components.recipe: Transparent fill, Pencil Gray uppercase 15px/700 text, 0.0530em tracking, 12px radius, 10px vertical and 16px horizontal padding, 2px Faded Gray border.

components.name: Section Headline
components.recipe: Feather-style 48-64px rounded display, weight 700, line-height 1.2, -0.0200em tracking, Eager Green.

components.name: Body Paragraph
components.recipe: Duolingo-sans style 17px/500 text, line-height 1.18, Pencil Gray, max width around 480px.

components.name: Footer Background
components.recipe: Eager Green fill, Paper White headers, Fresh Leaf or Storybook Green links, generous 48px vertical padding.

do: Use Eager Green for progress and CTA moments.
Use Spark Blue for interactive links and secondary CTAs.
Keep body text Pencil Gray at 17px and weight 500.
Pair text blocks with one large flat illustration.
dont: Do not put colored text inside body paragraphs.
Do not add gradients, shadows, or glass effects.
Do not use display type below 48px.
Do not apply illustration-only colors to UI chrome.
Do not stretch green into dense small text.

imagery.style: Flat storybook mascot and character illustration with rounded geometry and bold outlines.
rules: Place one large illustration beside text in each section.
Keep illustration-only secondary colors out of UI chrome.
Do not put illustrations inside cards or panels.

layout.sections: Single-column full-width sections, generally 800-900px tall, with 80-120px vertical breathing room.
layout.composition: Text-left and illustration-right rhythm with headline, paragraph, CTA, illustration, repeat.
layout.footer: Full-bleed Eager Green band spanning page width.
layout.avoid: No dense card grids or multi-column feature dashboards.

preview.note: Refero exposes preview imagery, but local download was not captured in this environment.
